# অর্পণ · Arpan

> Bengali community sharing app for Dhaka — give what you no longer need, take what you do. Free, neighbourly, kind.

Arpan (অর্পণ) connects neighbours in Dhaka, Bangladesh so people can pass on items they no longer need to others who do — at no cost. Categories include furniture, mobility aids, clothing, books, household goods, and more.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Browse free items posted by neighbours in Dhaka.
